structure.unit: State Agencies Related to the General Operation of Government

law.catch_line: What Comptroller may do with old books and papers
law.text: The Comptroller may dispense with all noncurrent books, papers, invoices, financial documents, and similar papers belonging to his office in a manner prescribed by the Virginia Public Records Act (§ 42.1-76 et seq.) in coordination with the needs of the Auditor of Public Accounts.
